WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, a level later for each point spent in another tree. Talent effects are Blizzard's November 2 notes; trained ranks and costs are read from the client, build 1.60.1.70938. Blizzard has not changed Rogue since launch beyond two tooltip fixes on November 6. The builds are Icy Veins' (updated November 4), Wowhead's (November 6 and 11) and WoWSims' presets, each named. Wowhead's Assassination pages still describe VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCauses your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec. as a finishing move and MutilateMutilateLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeInstantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. at 30 in places; that is the beta tree, and of its builds only the level 60 one is used here. Nothing about level 60 is measured: no raid opens before December 9. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

What Assassination is for

Poison damage on one target, with a builder that does not need you behind it. MutilateMutilateLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeInstantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. at level 40 costs 60 Energy, strikes with both daggers for 90% weapon damage plus 40 each, awards 2 combo points, and deals 20% more to a poisoned target. Before 40 the tree gives you crit and poison passives: MaliceMaliceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%., LethalityLethalityTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%., Vile PoisonsVile PoisonsTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects., and from 21 points VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCauses your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec., which turns each ShankShankSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost5 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy. Shank cannot Miss. into 6 seconds of +30% poison damage and +20% chance to apply poisons. Cold BloodCold BloodTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. at 16 points guarantees a crit on your next Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeAn instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point., BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeBackstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Awards 1 combo point., AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point., EviscerateEviscerateLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 EnergyRangeMeleeFinishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power: 1 point : 6-10 damage 2 points: 11-15 damage 3 points: 16-20 damage 4 points: 21-25 damage 5 points: 26-30 damage or MutilateMutilateLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeInstantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. The sources agree on the shape and differ on the levelling. Icy Veins, updated November 9, calls its single-target damage "some of the strongest in the game", says VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCauses your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec. "is a bit weak in its current state", and warns that some enemies are immune to poison. Wowhead's levelling page, updated November 6, calls Assassination "by far the least viable leveling option"; that page still places MutilateMutilateLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeInstantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. at 30, so read the verdict with the wait to 40 in mind. Our own reading, not a source's: levels 10 to 39 are the cost of this spec.

Stat priority

While levelling, from Icy Veins: weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina. MutilateMutilateLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeInstantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points. needs two daggers, so from the high 30s keep a second dagger with high top-end damage.

At 60 the two sites order the top differently, and both say it is early.

  • Icy Veins: Expertise to 6.5%, Hit to 8%, Agility, weapon damage, critical strike.
  • Wowhead, which calls its own list "purely speculative for endgame": Hit to 8%, Expertise to 6.5%, weapon skill, then Hit on to 17% for poisons, Agility, critical strike.
  • WoWSims' stored weights put Hit and Expertise level with each other, then Agility and critical strike. They were not retuned after the November 3 talent rework (WoWSims' model).

Wowhead's reason for chasing Hit past 8% is specific to this spec: poisons use the spell hit cap. PrecisionPrecisionTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 3%. gives 3% of it.

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons are a secondary skill and a poison and a sharpening stone now go on the same weapon. Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 deals 13 to 17 with 60 charges, and every poison carries more charges than in Classic. Attack Power counts for more: Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem adds 1% of it and Deadly PoisonDeadly PoisonItem 0.9%, per Blizzard's November 2 notes. At level 60

In a group you are single-target damage and control. Icy Veins, updated November 9: Assassination is "likely to struggle in encounters that consistently spawn small mobs", and giving up Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 EnergyCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. "can make it a bit more challenging to fit into groups." Both sites list poison-immune enemies as the spec's specific weakness.
